name: FrontierScience
intro: FrontierScience 通过奥赛与研究两条互补轨道评估专家级科学推理。42 位国际奥赛奖牌得主或国家队教练创作封闭答案题，45 位博士科学家创作开放研究子问题；专家从 500+ 与 200+ 候选中筛出 100 道奥赛题和 60 道研究题开源黄金集。
build_method: 奥赛与博士专家原创命题, 多轮领域专家评审, 元评审筛选
metric: 分轨准确率；研究题以 ≥7/10 为成功
task_type: 开放式科学问答, 短答案科学推理
eval_feature: 双轨评测, 过程评分标准, 内部模型筛难, 保留集防污染
scale: 数百题；开源黄金集 100 道奥赛题 + 60 道研究题
task_type_en: Open-ended Science QA, Short-answer Scientific Reasoning
build_method_en: Original Olympiad and PhD-expert authoring, multi-round domain review, expert meta-review
eval_feature_en: Dual-track Evaluation, Process Rubrics, Internal-model Difficulty Filtering, Held-out Contamination Tracking
intro_en: FrontierScience evaluates expert scientific reasoning through complementary Olympiad and Research tracks. Forty-two international medalists or national-team coaches author closed-answer tasks and 45 PhD scientists author open research subproblems; expert meta-review filters 500+ and 200+ candidates into an open gold set of 100 Olympiad and 60 Research items.
scale_en: Hundreds of questions; open gold set of 100 Olympiad + 60 Research items

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.21165v1 Sections 2.1–2.4 and 3.1 and the pinned Hugging Face release openai/frontierscience at revision 25ed67db7da8f4591484e764008ff585544f5a30. The Olympiad track uses 42 medalists or national-team coaches with 108 total medals; the Research track uses 45 PhD scientists and targets authentic three-to-five-hour subproblems. Tasks are selected against internal models, independently reviewed at least once for Olympiad and twice for Research, then receive holistic or meta-review. More than 500 Olympiad and 200 Research candidates yield a 100 Olympiad + 60 Research open gold set. Its 160 records expose problem, answer, subject, and task_group_id; for Research records, answer stores the rubric. Olympiad answers use the paper's GPT-5 high-effort equivalence judge over 20 trials; Research uses independent 10-point rubric items, GPT-5 high-effort judging, a 7-point success threshold, and 30 trials. The public release contains no evaluator repository: the exact judge implementation and output parser are not released.
